column1: # English notes for the mapping tables on the English site (docs/gen_tables.py).
# data/*.tsv stay the source of truth. The converter reads only the `effects` rows of dropped
# effects (crates/transform/src/effects.rs): they are the reason shown in the log when messages
# are in English, and a test requires one for every dropped effect.
# Columns (tab-separated): table (data/<table>.tsv), key (first column of the row), English note.
# A row of data/*.tsv whose note contains Cyrillic and has no line here keeps the Russian note,
# and gen_tables.py prints a warning — add the translation here.
